narrative:
Hamilton County has 615,755 registered voters, with 11.7% unaffiliated or lacking primary history. Republican-leaning voters make up 18.1% of registrants and Democratic-leaning voters account for 60.1%, a pronounced Democratic lean of 42.0 percentage points. Millennials are the largest generational cohort at 30.7% of registrants. Registration is trending bluer in younger age cohorts (1990s–2000s births lean +6.7% D−R vs -0.7% for 1950s–60s cohorts).
